question: Who first presided over the first Indian National Congress session at Mumbai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**W C Bannerjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Womesh Chunder Bannerjee (W C Bannerjee)** was the first president of the **Indian National Congress** (INC).
 
• The **first session of the Indian National Congress** was held at **Bombay (Mumbai)** in December 1885.
 
• W C Bannerjee was a prominent Indian lawyer, nationalist, and political lead
